item.title: 2.0.0 — Every sport, one tab, twelve languages
item.description: ArenaSwap 2.0 rebuilds the scoring engine, grows from basketball to 31 leagues across six sports, replaces the settings screen with something you can find things in, and ships in twelve languages.
